text:
alex: Quick check — v2 rollout liaison sync. I want to confirm owners for the next 48h ramp. Plan: canary 5% -> 20% tomorrow -> 100% Friday if metrics OK.

mina: I can own the SDK consumers side for the ramp. I'll gate the Node and Python clients — releasing 2.0.0-rc3 tonight.

chris: I'll take infra changes: proxy routing, header mapping, and fallback shim. PR is #4321, awaiting infra review.

olivia: Product wants the deprecation banner live on dashboard before 20% ramp. Can we have an API header `X-Deprecation-Notice` emitted?

chris: yes, added in #4321. Example header: `X-Deprecation-Notice: v1 deprecates 2026-05-01`. Will add flag to toggle.

alex: deploy-bot: schedule canary for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC and will start at 5%.

deploy-bot: @alex scheduled canary deploy slot 2026-03-18T02:00Z (slot id: slot-887). Starting percentage: 5%.

mina: SDK TODOs: publish rc, update migration guide, add runtime fallback snippet. Snippet:
```bash
# switch to v2 endpoint with fallback to v1
export REDWOOD_API=https://api.redwood.com/v2
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" $REDWOOD_API/generate || curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

alex: chris — infra dependency: does the feature flag live in config-service or env? We need a simple toggle `enable_v2_routing`.

chris: config-service. I'll add `feature_flags.enable_v2_routing` and wire it to the gateway by tomorrow morning. Tagging eng-infra for rollout window.

mina: SDK CI: sdk-ci-bot, please run compatibility smoke against canary slot once deployed (tests: boot, simple-generate, streaming). PRs: #4329 (node), #4330 (python).

sdk-ci-bot: Queued compatibility run against slot-887. Will post results to this thread.

olivia: Metrics to watch: 95th latency, error-rate >0.5%, token cost drift >10%. If any trigger hits, rollback to 0% and notify owners.

alex: For ASYNC followups — please post any unresolved blockers here. If all good, ack with :thumbsup: and we'll proceed with the schedule.

chris: ack :thumbsup:

mina: ack :thumbsup:

olivia: ack :thumbsup:

sdk-ci-bot: compatibility run finished: node: PASS, python: PASS, streaming: PASS. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/7890

deploy-bot: canary slot-887 reached 20% at 2026-03-18T08:00Z per ramp plan.

alex: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as source of truth for owner pings. I'll follow up Friday for 100% cutover unless we see regressions.
